headline: Connecting Business Strategy with Hands-On Product Execution and Data-Dense UI Architecture
subheadline: I bring over a decade of experience bridging strategy, rapid AI-first prototyping, and scalable UX systems to deliver high-impact digital products for Work & Co and its clients.

painPoints.title: Solving Complex Product & Strategy Challenges
painPoints.desc: With 12+ years leading UX and product strategy across health-tech, fintech, and enterprise spaces, I synthesize complex, data-heavy workflows into clear, user-centered digital solutions.

painPoints.title: Iterative Prototyping & Cross-Functional Speed
painPoints.desc: I pioneer AI-first prototyping workflows using tools like Cursor, Figma Make, and Copilot to rapidly test, validate, and collaborate with developers and product teams in real time.

coverLetterText:
Dear Hiring Team at Work & Co,

I have followed Work & Co’s work for years, particularly your commitment to shipping hands-on, high-impact digital products without the friction of bloated overhead. As a Senior Product Designer and UX Strategist with over 12 years of experience leading complex, data-dense digital transformations, I thrive in environments that value deep craft, rapid prototyping, and close cross-functional collaboration.

Throughout my career—spanning fintech enterprise environments at OneAmerica, scaled SaaS platforms at StackSource, and my current role leading product design at Allied Solutions—I have focused on bridging high-level business strategy with rigorous visual and interaction design. At Allied Solutions, I introduced an AI-first prototyping workflow using Cursor, Figma Make, and Copilot to rapidly iterate on complex data reporting software, resulting in a perfect 5/5 SUPR-Q usability score in beta.

Work & Co’s philosophy of prototyping early, working directly alongside leadership and engineering, and testing relentlessly matches my exact operational style. Whether architecting AI-driven semantic interfaces or designing enterprise dashboards, I view design as an end-to-end discipline where strategy, user empathy, and technical execution meet.

I would love the opportunity to discuss how my systems-thinking mindset and hands-on execution can contribute to Work & Co’s ongoing success.

Warmly,
Nicole Whitis-Purva
